title: Session
description: The signed-in user's session as reactive state: resolves to { userId, role?, user } or null, updating live as auth actions sign the user in and out. Resolves to null outside browsers, so statically generated pages render the signed-out state

resolve.description: SessionInfo { userId, role?, user } for the signed-in user, or null (always null outside browsers)

parameters.description: Called with the new SessionInfo|null whenever the session store changes

subscribe.description: Subscribe to session changes (auth actions bump the store after sign-in/out)
